title: astronia glabra
intro: Astronia glabra, commonly known as Astronia, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia and Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and prevent the formation of blood clots. The therapeutic actions of Astronia glabra include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and anticoagulant activities. The bioactive constituents of Astronia glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
